725:t_014:9.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「He is right! You have already strayed from this world's natural order!」

725:t_014:10.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Though you are living beings, your source is the force that seeks to vanish...! At some point, it began eating away at your hearts!」

725:t_014:11.en:
$$甲児$$
「You died once and came back. You're no different from ghosts! Don't think you have a place in this world!」

725:t_014:12.en:
$$タケル$$
「Return to the world of darkness, apostles of darkness! This world belongs to the living!」

725:t_014:13.en:
$$タケル$$
「We'll settle this here! We'll erase your existence from this world completely!」

725:t_015:0.en:
$$トライア$$
「So even the higher-dimensional beings with evil wills have finally perished...」

725:t_015:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「They said they came here after defeating the other higher-dimensional beings. I suppose only we and the $$御使い$$s remain in this universe now.」

725:t_016:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Your coming to $$エス・テラン$$ means you heard the truth about the $$御使い$$s from $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$.」

725:t_016:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You need not say it aloud. I understand your disappointment.」

725:t_016:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It is impossible to understand one another with them. Their arrogance is truly that of merciless gods.」

725:t_016:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I hate to admit it, but you're right.」

725:t_016:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「And you must have learned how powerless you are. Will you advance even so?」

725:t_016:8.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then fight me first, to settle all the ties between us.」

725:t_016:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「...I've got no objection. Let's go, $$アサキム$$.」

725:t_016:10.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You are as fiery as ever, $$ザ・ヒート$$. But this is not the place for our final battle.」

725:t_016:11.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I will await you on $$エス・テラン$$'s equator, at 150 degrees east longitude.」

725:t_017:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「I never expected $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ himself to challenge us to an open battle.」

725:t_017:1.en:
$$桂$$
「So he's getting serious for the first and last time.」

725:t_017:2.en:
$$シン$$
「Just what I wanted! I'll pay you back for the $$多元戦争$$!」

725:t_017:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「But we must overcome that power of immortality...」

725:t_017:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「We'll have to leave that to Chief.」

725:t_017:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「Yes... I'll figure something out.」

725:t_017:6.en:
$$トライア$$
(I can figure that part out, at least...)

725:t_017:7.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, return. We will descend to $$エス・テラン$$ as soon as preparations are complete.」

725:t_017:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It is the planet where the $$御使い$$s dwell and $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ awaits...」

725:t_017:10.en:
$n
(That is when I will fulfill my mission...)

725:t_018:0.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「You approach without knowing fear, just like gnats.」

725:t_018:1.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Then let us show them...」

725:t_018:3.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「First, behold my dark flames!」

725:t_019:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's $$次元力|lc$$! It appears to have the power to heal some of the damage they take!」

725:t_019:2.en:
$$ズール$$
「Next, behold my power... the dark barrier...!」

725:t_020:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now some kind of field has appeared around those three!」

725:t_020:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「So it's something like a barrier that blocks our attacks!」

725:t_020:2.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Finally, behold my power... the dark hole!」

725:t_021:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Each of the three uses a different, troublesome power!」

725:t_021:2.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Did you see that, Earthlings?! This is the power of a god!」

725:t_021:3.en:
$$ズール$$
「Your defeat before our power is inevitable...!」

725:t_021:4.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Surrender to us now, and we will at least spare your lives.」

725:t_021:5.en:
$$甲児$$
「You think threats like that will work on us?!」

725:t_021:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$ハーデス$$ heals damage, $$ズール$$ has a barrier that blocks one attack, and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ moves through subspace...」

725:t_021:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My calculations indicate they can only use those powers once per minute.」

725:t_021:8.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Knowing that, we can find a way to fight them!」

725:t_021:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「Whatever power you use, we'll overcome it!」

725:t_021:10.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「It will be entertaining to see how long your bravado lasts.」

725:t_021:11.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「But you cannot defeat us.」

725:t_021:12.en:
$$ズール$$
「Indeed... As long as you remain human.」

725:t_022:0.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「I-impossiiiiible! I, $$ハーデス$$, king of the underworld, defeated by mere humans!!」

725:t_022:1.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Know that your arrogance has brought destruction upon an eternal god of $$オリュンポス$$!」

725:t_022:2.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Th-then, one day, I shall rise aga...」

725:t_022:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's useless! However many times you return, as long as we... no, as long as people who never abandon hope exist, you'll always be defeated!」

725:t_022:5.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「U-uaaaagh! M-my body... My soul is perishing!!」

725:t_023:0.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「$$ハーデス$$' soul was swallowed by defeat, and the gods of $$オリュンポス$$ who drew power from him also perished. Then he fell completely into darkness.」

725:t_023:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「So he can't come back anymore.」

725:t_023:2.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「$$甲児$$. That is because your words shattered his soul.」

725:t_023:3.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Allow me to praise you once again. You are the heroes of steel.」

725:t_024:0.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「M-my soul is perishing! My soul, which became the incarnation of a black hole!」

725:t_024:1.en:
$$グーラ$$
「This is goodbye, Father. You will probably never be able to return again.」

725:t_024:2.en:
$$グーラ$$
「The dark power that is your source of strength will fall before the sunlight of $$正太郎$$ and his friends.」

725:t_024:3.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Why?! Why won't you give in to despair?! Why aren't you swallowed by darkness?!」

725:t_024:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's our strength... Our hearts believe in hope!」

725:t_024:5.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Hope... I cannot acknowledge such a thing...」

725:t_024:6.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Remember, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$! Even you must have had hope!」

725:t_024:7.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Isn't that why you put your son $$グーラ$$ in a capsule twelve thousand years ago and sent him away from your planet?!」

725:t_024:8.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「...Yes... Back then, I... wanted at least $$グーラ$$ to survive...」

725:t_024:9.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That was hope... I... entrusted my hope to $$グーラ$$...」

725:t_024:11.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Live, $$グーラ$$... With the hope we forgot.」

725:t_024:12.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That is... your father's... last... wish...」

725:t_025:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
(At the very end, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ regained a little of the heart he had as a human...)

725:t_025:2.en:
$$正太郎$$
(We will never forget that we are human... We believe that will give birth to hope...)
